terms.description: An LLM-driven reviewer produced this record. Always explicit; absence never means agent.
A non-model tool, linter, or scanner produced this record.
A human reviewer produced this record.
The record was migrated from a legacy contract by the taxonomy migration tool.
The producer could not be determined and must not be defaulted to agent.
Evidence was collected and is attached to the observation.
Some but not all expected evidence was collected.
No evidence could be collected. Describes coverage only; it is not a pass or a block.
The evidence establishes conformance for the review or aspect.
The evidence raises a qualified concern short of failure.
The evidence establishes non-conformance for the review or aspect.
The evidence does not establish either pass or fail.
The aspect does not apply to this subject.
The aspect has not yet been evaluated.
A before/after comparison shows improvement.
A before/after comparison shows regression.
A before/after comparison shows both improvement and regression.
A before/after comparison shows no material difference.
No before/after delta was observed for this change.
A before/after comparison could not be established.
Policy permits the change to proceed. Requires a policyRef; never supplied by a raw finding.
Policy flags the change but does not block it.
Policy prevents the change from proceeding.
Policy defers the disposition pending further evidence.
The highest severity band.
A high severity finding.
A medium severity finding.
A low severity finding.
An informational finding with no required action.
The issue has not been triaged to a terminal state.
A human accepted the risk of the issue.
A human waived the issue.
A human determined the issue does not apply.
The issue was resolved by a reviewed change, not by a model's silent omission.
A reference into reviewed source code.
A test execution result.
A measurement taken from a running system.
Structured output from a deterministic tool.
A build or deployment artifact reference.
Free-form textual evidence, including imported legacy evidence strings.
A human's direct statement of fact.
